description: Defensive layer for mlx / mlx-lm / mlx-vlm on Apple Silicon. Prevents IOGPUFamily kernel panics, SIGABRT, and Mac reboots from MLX inference. Includes a community-curated registry of known-panic models (KNOWN_PANIC_MODELS) with hardware contexts, root-cause hypotheses, and verified workarounds.
